preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the graph.
No self-loops are present in the graph.

preconditions.expression: No multiple edges are present in the graph.
preconditions.description: Each pair of vertices is connected by at most one edge.
Each edge is colored either red or blue.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output == k and k > 0 and k <= n)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if it's impossible to make all edges the same color, or a positive integer k followed by k integers representing the sequence of moves.

postconditions.expression: output == k and k > 0 and k <= n
postconditions.description: If the output is a sequence of moves, then k is the number of moves and each move is an integer between 1 and n.
If the output is -1, then it's impossible to make all edges the same color.

invariants.expression: all(c_i in {'R', 'B'} for i in range(m))
invariants.description: All edges are initially colored either red or blue.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u_i, v_i <= n for i in range(m))
invariants.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the graph.

invariants.expression: all(u_i != v_i for i in range(m))
invariants.description: No self-loops are present in the graph.

invariants.expression: all(not is_multiple_edge(u_i, v_i, edges) for i in range(m))
invariants.description: No multiple edges are present in the graph.
